AHJ: Authority Having Jurisdiction; local building/fire/accessibility authority whose requirements override defaults
as-built: Record of constructed conditions after completion; update when field differs from issued CD
BD: Buildings Department; HK statutory authority for structures, windows, and building works submissions
BEAM Plus: Building Environmental Assessment Method Plus; Hong Kong green building rating framework
BOH: Back of House; service, storage, and staff zones (typical retail/hospitality split vs FOH)
BOQ: Bill of Quantities; measured scope schedule for tender/pricing
BMS: Building Management System; central monitoring/control for HVAC, lighting, access, and alarms
CCT: Correlated Color Temperature in Kelvin; warm (2700K) to cool (4000K+)
CoP: Code of Practice; e.g. EMSD Electricity (Wiring) Regulations CoP for HK electrical design review
CRI: Color Rendering Index; fidelity of light source vs natural light (80+ typical for interiors)
DD: Design Development; coordinated details, materials, schedules
DLP: Defects Liability Period; post-handover warranty/defect tracking window
ELV: Extra-Low Voltage; data, AV, security, BMS systems
EMSD: Electrical and Mechanical Services Department; HK authority for electrical/gas/lift statutory works
FOH: Front of House; customer-facing sales, dining, or lobby zones
FS: Fire / Life Safety systems and requirements
FSD: Fire Services Department; HK authority for fire protection, alarms, and means of escape
G-B-B: Good-Better-Best; structured value-engineering comparison preserving design intent tiers
HKAS: 香港仲裁公會; co-publisher of HKRG; dispute resolution referenced in standard quotation
HKEDCA: Hong Kong Engineering & Decoration Contractors Association 裝修業界攻略 — industry trade guide
HKBIA: 香港樓宇檢驗學會; co-publisher of HKRG renovation guidelines
HKRG: 香港裝修指引 / 裝修資訊 — client-contractor process, acceptance, standard quotation
HVAC: Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning; clash priority below FS and P&D in RCP coordination
LD: Labour Department; HK authority for occupational safety, scaffold, and working-at-height rules
LEED: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design; US green building certification (map to BEAM Plus in HK)
LLF: Lamp Lumen Maintenance Factor; luminaire output depreciation over lamp life
LOD: Level of Detail; drawing information depth matched to scale
Lux: Illuminance unit (lm/m²); target levels vary by space type — see SKILL §1.6
MF: Maintenance Factor; combined lamp, luminaire, and room surface depreciation in lighting calc
物料規格表: Material / finishes schedule; fixed finishes, joinery, sanitary, lighting, doors — template material-schedule.md under interior-material-procurement
現狀平面圖: Existing-condition floor plan (typical tender sheet P0); baseline for demolition and site remeasure — not a substitute for field measure
物料標示圖: Material indication plan (e.g. floor/sill hatch legend on tender sheet P2); codes must map to 物料規格表
自購: Owner-supplied / owner-purchased item marked on drawings; exclude from contractor BOQ; list on material-schedule owner-supply sheets
選樣: Showroom or sample selection to lock brand/model/colour before contractor procurement
樣版: Physical sample / catalogue sample submitted for designer approval before order
待選: Brand/model/colour not yet locked; typically requires 設計師陪同選購
或同等: Or equal; approved equivalent performance/appearance substitute — state equivalency note
設計師陪同選購: Designer accompanies owner at showroom to lock finish selections
採購方式: Procurement role on schedule: contractor catalogue sample, post-selection contractor buy, or owner-supply
practical completion: Stage when works are substantially complete and ready for handover/snag — aligns with 交收
RCD: Residual Current Device; earth-leakage protection required per EMSD CoP in HK installations
RFI: Request for Information; formal query during tender or construction admin
RT60: Reverberation time; seconds for sound decay 60 dB in a space
Rw: Weighted sound reduction index; ISO/EN partition rating equivalent to STC
SD: Schematic Design; planning set with preliminary RCP/MEP intent
SI: Site Instruction; formal field directive for contractor action
snag: Punch-list defect item logged at handover; closure tracked through DLP — 執漏 in HK residential
STC: Sound Transmission Class; US partition rating
UGR: Unified Glare Rating; discomfort glare metric for lighting
VE: Value Engineering; cost-aligned alternatives preserving intent
VO: Variation Order; contract change for scope/cost/time
WAH: Working at Height; LD-regulated; halt on typhoon signals for exterior scaffold works
WELL: WELL Building Standard; occupant wellness certification (air, light, materials, comfort)
WSD: Water Supplies Department; HK authority for plumbing submissions and waterworks
客方: Client/owner party in HKRG contract workflow; pays estate deposits, retention list, third-party supply
承辦方: Contractor party in HKRG contract; executes trades, protection, waste removal, snag rectification
裝修: Renovation/fit-out works; triggers HK mode (BD/FSD/EMSD/WSD/LD + estate + HKEDCA/HKRG)
裝修工序: HK residential trade sequence: 清拆 → 水電 → 坭水/防水 → 木工前期 → 油漆 → 木工後期 → 雜項 → 交收
裝修師傅: On-site renovation lead / fit-out trades supervisor (colloquial HK)
裝修需知: HKRG Part 1; client–contractor duties, trade rules, and 額外工程費 triggers
裝修資訊: Web publication name for HKRG 香港裝修指引 on HKAS site
保留清單: Pre-demolition retention list; client confirms items not to hack — HKRG attachment form
假天花: Suspended/false ceiling; early carpentry trade — coordinate MEP, sprinklers, and lighting coves
內籠: Internal tile substrate wall build-up before finish tile fixing
判頭承辦: Contractor execution role in HKRG client-contractor workflow
剷底: Scrape walls to bare concrete before paint; HK paint prep — HKRG limits shrinkage/colour count
打拆: Demolition/hacking works; includes 打拆驗收 checks before next trade
批盪: Plaster/render; must be dry before fixed joinery and late-stage carpentry
搭棚: Bamboo/metal scaffolding; requires estate approval, engineer design, LD safety compliance
翻執: Rework of completed work; costly — often from premature protection removal or damage
執爛: Snag fix, especially masonry/plaster defects — 坭水執爛 before handover
掛牌: Estate management alarm isolate permit for fire-triggering works
木門: Timber doors; late carpentry — install after scaffold removal and rain protection in place
木工: Carpentry/joinery trade split into 前期 (假天花/燈槽) and 後期 (門/地板/玻璃)
木地板: Timber flooring; lay only after window glass installed for rain protection
水電: Plumbing and electrical rough-in; follows 清拆, before 坭水 concealment
泥頭: Construction waste/rubble; contractor typically responsible for removal off site
油漆: Paint works; after early carpentry/plaster dry — protect finishes with canvas and 油漆未乾 signage
油漆未乾: Site signage for wet paint; close windows before rain to prevent wash-back
盪地台: Floor screed/leveling; no traffic until strength — pad loads on finished plaster
英坭沙: Cement:sand screed mix; substrate for tiles — typical HK masonry build-up layer
訂造傢俬: Custom/bespoke joinery/cabinets; layout must be fixed before MEP rough-in
谷磅: Electrical conduit chasing in walls; measured per HKEDCA/HKRG BOQ rules
防水: Waterproofing membrane in wet areas; barrier + signage until finish pave after cure
雜項: Miscellaneous fixtures trade — sanitaryware, hardware, stone sills, final devices before 交收
驗收: Inspection and acceptance testing at handover
驗收指引: HKRG Part 2; owner self-inspection checklist — 自助驗收 with itemized pass/fail criteria
自助驗收: Owner-led snag walk using HKRG 驗收指引 before final sign-off
清拆: Demolition works; first HK residential renovation trade
燈槽: Cove/light trough in false ceiling; early carpentry item coordinated with RCP
額外工程費: Additional works charge; HKRG lists trade-specific 另收費 items unless included in quote
屋苑管理處: Estate management office; renovation permits, scaffold, 掛牌, neighbour complaint interface
